tasks.title: The objectives list still says "OUR" on a line the enemy just took
tasks.why: MEASURED, from flip_hud_crop.png (ObjectiveTracker.cs:51-52, NameOf: `def.SideTeam == 0 ? "OUR " + kind : "ENEMY "+kind`, fixed at the row's construction) against the bullet colour (Refresh, lines 77-80, which does track the live owner). At the captured moment "OUR MAINLINE" shows the same red/orange dot as every "ENEMY ..." row below it, while "OUR RESERVELINE" and "OUR HQ" show white - i.e. the dot is telling the truth (that sector is now the enemy's) and the four words beside it are not. The centre banner that should carry this news is gone in 3 s (HudLayout.BannerSeconds) and fires only on the `TrenchCaptured` event at the instant it happens; the list is the only lasting read a player gets (plan step 5), and right now its one piece of text contradicts its own colour on the exact row that matters most, the player's own front line falling. A player glancing back at the panel after missing the banner reads "OUR MAINLINE" and believes it still theirs.
tasks.done_when: After a sector's SectorStates.Owner changes, the row's Name.text is rebuilt to lead with the current holder (e.g. "ENEMY-HELD MAINLINE" or swapping OUR/ENEMY to match st.Owner) instead of the fixed def.SideTeam, checked by a HudTextTests case that flips an objective's owner and asserts the row text changes, and by a fresh flip_hud.png whose objectives-panel crop shows no row where the bullet colour and the leading word disagree.
